title: Turning off Secure Boot in a homelab because it fights with DKMS is a worse idea than it looks, even now that Debian 13.8 fixes a bypass
content_md:
Turning off Secure Boot in a homelab because it "fights with DKMS" is a worse idea than it looks, even now that Debian 13.8 fixes a bypass.

Original article: https://asturia.es/blog/2026-11-22-debian-13-8-y-el-comando-serial-de-grub-que-se-saltaba-secure-boot
exclude_reason: Homelab blog opinion on Secure Boot and DKMS, not a report of a new incident or advisory.
